name: npu-capacity
command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260731T064607Z/image-r2")
nodes=json.loads((root/"nodes.json").read_text())["items"]
pods=json.loads((root/"all-pods.json").read_text())["items"]
resource="huawei.com/Ascend910"
active={}
details=[]
for pod in pods:
    node=pod.get("spec",{}).get("nodeName")
    phase=pod.get("status",{}).get("phase")
    if not node or phase in {"Succeeded","Failed"}:
        continue
    regular=sum(int(c.get("resources",{}).get("requests",{}).get(resource,"0")) for c in pod.get("spec",{}).get("containers",[]))
    init=max([int(c.get("resources",{}).get("requests",{}).get(resource,"0")) for c in pod.get("spec",{}).get("initContainers",[])]+[0])
    request=max(regular,init)
    if request:
        active[node]=active.get(node,0)+request
        details.append({"namespace":pod["metadata"]["namespace"],"name":pod["metadata"]["name"],"node":node,"phase":phase,"request":request})
result={}
for node in nodes:
    name=node["metadata"]["name"]
    ready=any(c["type"]=="Ready" and c["status"]=="True" for c in node["status"].get("conditions",[]))
    alloc=int(node["status"].get("allocatable",{}).get(resource,"0"))
    used=active.get(name,0)
    result[name]={"ready":ready,"allocatable":alloc,"active_requests":used,"free":alloc-used if ready else 0}
print(json.dumps({"resource":resource,"nodes":result,"requesting_pods":details},sort_keys=True,indent=2))'
